The Oct 4, 10, 11 and 24 dinners below carry over from the Sept 11 research and were NOT re-confirmed. Call 619-295-3939 before publishing.

vendors.siteNotes: Open. Ticket prices are not published on the site; the calendar loads through an external ticketing widget that could not be read. A tourism listing gives a $20-$25 range for Mainstage and $18 for Sunday Company, unverified.

The website was returning a Cloudflare 521 (server down) at time of research, so the IG hours are used. The happy hour below is third-party only and could not be checked against the venue's own page. IG bio also advertises vinyl selectors every weekend, with no days or times given.

vendors.tagline: Italian restaurant and wine bar in Mission Hills

CONFLICT on the venue's own site: the Specials page says brunch is Saturday and Sunday 10:00-14:30 while the homepage hours show Saturday opening at 17:00. The Events page reads 'Red Door events coming soon!'. The adjacent Bar by Red Door shares this address; its own domain could not be fetched.

vendors.name: La Puerta Mission Hills
vendors.tagline: Mexican food, tequila and mezcal

IMPORTANT: lapuertasd.com/happy-hour lists itemized deals (half-off Monday, $3 Taco Tuesday, late-night specials) but that page shows ONLY the Downtown/Gaslamp address, so those deals are NOT applied here. The only Mission Hills happy hour statement on the site is '3-5 daily' printed next to the Goldfinch address. The owners are also taking over the former Harley Gray space on W Washington for a new concept.

A KPBS listing gives $17 members, $18 at the box office, $20 booking online, plus $125 annual membership for two; treat as indicative. Saturday Oct 3 is a private rental with no public access and is excluded.

vendors.name: Mission Hills Town Council

Board meets at Safdie Rabines Architects, Town Halls at Francis Parker Lower School; NO street addresses are published for either venue on the MHTC site, so any addresses in an older seed file were assumed, not sourced. The Special Events and Concerts pages both currently read 'No upcoming events found'. Only Oct, Nov and Dec 2026 meetings are published; do not extrapolate into 2027.

CAUTION: radiance-yoga.net is an UNRELATED studio in Alexandria, Virginia. Eventbrite also lists this venue under two spellings with slightly different pins, so pick one canonical record.

vendors.address: 1920 Fort Stockton Dr, San Diego, CA 92103

vendors.name: Pioneer Park
vendors.siteNotes: Grass area, playground, tennis courts across the street, restroom, small lot plus street parking. Reservable for picnics and weddings, capacity 300; no inflatables or glass, food permitted. The City page lists NO recurring programming. The Town Council's Concerts in the Park run here but have no published dates.

vendors.name: Harley Gray Kitchen & Bar
vendors.address: 902 W Washington St, San Diego, CA 92103
vendors.siteNotes: CLOSED permanently on December 19, 2025 after 12 years. NOTE its address was 902 W Washington St, not 4040 Goldfinch St (that is Cinema Under The Stars). The space is being taken over by the La Puerta owners for a new, unnamed Mission Hills concept. Do not publish.

vendors.name: Thorn Brewing Mission Hills
vendors.address: 4026 Hawk St Suite A, San Diego, CA 92103
vendors.siteNotes: CLOSED. Still listed in the BID directory, which is out of date. The space is now Longball Cocktail Club & Golf Simulator. Do not publish.

Confirm the venue name before listing.
